Secs. 46-91 Designated “NO THRU TRUCKS” area. No “thru trucks” shall be allowed to use any Town of Mount Airy maintained road in the corporate limits, of Habersham County, Georgia, except as may be otherwise authorized by law, that do / does not have a point of destination, service, pick-up or delivery at a location directly accessible by use of, said County road(s). For the purpose of this section, the term “thru trucks” shall be defined as every motor vehicle designated, used or maintained primarily for the transportation of property as defined by O.C.G.A 40-1-1 – 40-6-52. For the purpose of this section, “thru trucks” shall include, but will not be limited to, any and all commercial motor vehicles (trucks with more than 6 wheels) including tractor-trailers. For the purpose of this section, however, the term “thru truck” shall not include noncommercial motor vehicles, including, but not limited to, pick-up trucks, excluding buses and motorcoaches, government vehicles, emergency vehicles, utility provider vehicles. All designated “no thru trucks” areas and streets will be posted with required signage at each entrance. Secs. 46-92 No Overnight Parking.

No truck and/or tractor- trailer shall enter, travel or park on any street, or the rights-of-way in the corporate limits of the Town of Mount Airy, Habersham County, Georgia for the purpose of an overnight stay by the driver or operator. Dicks Hill Parkway, Hwy 197 at entrance of corporate limits shall be posted with required signage stating No Overnight Parking.
